prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Maryland?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” marketing agency in Maryland — the right agency depends on your goals, industry, budget, timeline and whether you need local in-person support or are fine with a remote partner. I can help you find the best match quickly if you tell me a few details. Meanwhile, here’s a practical way to decide and a short checklist to get you started.

What I need from you to make targeted recommendations
- Primary goal (brand awareness, lead generation, SEO, digital ads, social media, PR, content, full-service, etc.)
- B2B or B2C, and industry (tech, healthcare, professional services, real estate, nonprofit, retail, etc.)
- Monthly/annual marketing budget range
- Company size and existing marketing staff/skills
- Preference for a local Maryland office vs. fully remote/agency anywhere
- Timeline for results/campaign start

How to evaluate agencies (quick checklist)
- Experience in your industry and with the channel(s) you need
- Case studies and measurable results (ROAS, lead volume, SEO rankings, conversion rate improvements)
- Client references and online reviews
- Team structure: who will actually do the work vs. account manager
- Tools and reporting cadence (dashboards, KPIs, frequency)
- Pricing model (retainer, project, performance-based) and clarity of scope
- Cultural fit and communication style
- Contract terms, minimums, and exit terms

Questions to ask agencies in a discovery call
- Have you worked with companies like ours? Can you show results?
- What would you recommend for our primary goal and why?
- Who will be on our account and how much time will they dedicate?
- What KPIs do you measure and how often will you report?
- What is your typical onboarding process and timeline to show results?
- Can you provide 2–3 references from current/previous clients?

Red flags
- No measurable case studies or unwillingness to share references
- Vague deliverables or unclear pricing
- Guarantees that sound too good (e.g., “#1 on Google in 30 days”)
- Slow or evasive communication during sales process

If you want, I can:
- Suggest a shortlist of agencies in Maryland tailored to your needs (I’ll need the details above)
- Draft a short RFP/email template you can send to agencies
- Create a comparison matrix to evaluate proposals side-by-side

Which option would you like to do next? Provide the details above and I’ll compile a targeted shortlist and next steps.
